status: ENGINEERING SCREEN ONLY; NOT A SELECTED AXLE, BEARING OR GUIDE DESIGN

shaft_screen.diameter_status: Comparison diameters only. 50.8mm audits the unaccepted G1 display value. No candidate is selected.
shaft_screen.force_basis: Allocated upper coach rail load/8 multiplied by trial multiplier, used as a radial journal-force proxy. This is not a calculated journal reaction, design impact factor or bound on uneven loading.
shaft_screen.offset_status: Trial lever arms only; actual tire contact, wheel, bearing pressure-center and brake overhang geometry remains open.
shaft_screen.torque_status: Independent sensitivity values, NOT a maximum brake torque, an OEM rating or a validated fault load. D1 maximum applied torque still required.
shaft_screen.model: Solid uniform round section; bending M=Q*e, sigma=32*M/(pi*d^3); tau=16*T/(pi*d^3); elastic von Mises=sqrt(sigma^2+3*tau^2). Units converted to N,mm,MPa.
excludes: Actual material, toughness and heat treatment
Corrosion, wear, inspection interval and reliability targets

guide_screen.relative_angle_definition: Axle tilt relative to the local guide-frame datum. Delta is differential bearing-center height relative to that datum; it is not automatically equal to rail crosslevel or vehicle roll.
guide_screen.box_status: Illustrative rectangular-envelope calculation only; not actual box or guide dimensions.
guide_screen.acceptance: No allowable guide clearance assigned. Do not enlarge guide gaps on this basis without restraint, wear and stability design.

bearing_screen.status: Documented comparison leads only; neither has been selected or endorsed for this railway. Same boundary dimensions do not establish interchangeability.
bearing_screen.load_status: Hypothetical equivalent dynamic load P after radial/axial/load-distribution calculation; these values are not inferred directly from coach axle loads.
bearing_screen.formula: L10=(C/P)^(10/3), in million revolutions for roller bearings. Basic 90% fatigue-life model only.
excludes: Actual tapered-bearing induced axial forces and paired-setting calculations
Grease/seal contamination, water, washdown and long storage
Minimum load, temperature, clearance/preload and lubrication
Shaft/housing fits, support rigidity, skew and deflection
Supplier confirmation of rail application and controlled current drawing
